module_purpose: / IZINHLOSO ZALESI SIFUNDO Lesi sifundo inhloso-ngqangi yaso ukwelekelela nokuhlahlela indlela abafundi ukuze bazi imithetho yokubhalwa kwemisho esiZulwini, izinhlobo zemisho kanye nokuqondisisa ubunjalo bolimi lwesiZulu olungamagama nolungemagama, amakhono okusebenzisa lolu limi ngenkathi kuxhunyanwa ngalo nokwazi ulimi lwesiZulu nalawo angamadlela ndawonye nalo. The main aim of the module is to assist and guide the students to know and understand the nature of isiZulu verbal and non-verbal language and the communication skills thereof.
